import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long MOD;
    static int[] fact = new int[262155];
    static int[] invFact = new int[262155];
    static int[][] memo = new int[262155][31];
    static boolean[][] marked = new boolean[262155][31];
    static int[] log2arr = new int[262155];
    static int[] twoadicSum = new int[262155];
    static List<int[]> traversal = new ArrayList<>();

    static void readInt(DataInputStream in, int[] buffer, int[] idx) throws IOException {
        int c;
        buffer[idx[0]] = 0;
        boolean neg = false;
        while ((c = in.read()) != -1 && !Character.isDigit(c)) {
            if (c == '-') neg = true;
        }
        if (c == -1) return;
        do {
            buffer[idx[0]] = buffer[idx[0]] * 10 + (c - '0');
        } while ((c = in.read()) != -1 && Character.isDigit(c));
        if (neg) buffer[idx[0]] = -buffer[idx[0]];
    }

    static void readLL(DataInputStream in, long[] buffer, int[] idx) throws IOException {
        int c;
        buffer[idx[0]] = 0;
        boolean neg = false;
        while ((c = in.read()) != -1 && !Character.isDigit(c)) {
            if (c == '-') neg = true;
        }
        if (c == -1) return;
        do {
            buffer[idx[0]] = buffer[idx[0]] * 10 + (c - '0');
        } while ((c = in.read()) != -1 && Character.isDigit(c));
        if (neg) buffer[idx[0]] = -buffer[idx[0]];
    }

    static int modExp(int base, long exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (int) (((long) res * base) % MOD);
            }
            base = (int) (((long) base * base) % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int get2adic(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while ((x & 1) == 0 && x != 0) {
            ++cnt;
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static int binomial(int N, int M) {
        return (int) (((long) fact[N] * invFact[M]) % MOD * invFact[N - M] % MOD);
    }

    static int recursiveDP(int N, int K) {
        if (N == 0) return 1;
        if (K == 0) return 0;
        if (memo[N][K] != -1) return memo[N][K];
        
        int step = 1 << log2arr[N];
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = N; i >= step; i -= 2) {
            sum = (int) ((sum + (long) binomial(N, i) * recursiveDP(N - i, K - 1) % MOD * K) % MOD);
        }
        return memo[N][K] = sum;
    }

    static int iterativeDP(int N, int K) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{N, K});
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int curN = cur[0];
            int curK = cur[1];
            traversal.add(new int[]{curN, curK});
            
            if (curN == 0 || curK == 0) continue;
            
            int step = 1 << log2arr[curN];
            for (int i = curN; i >= step; i -= 2) {
                if (twoadicSum[i] + twoadicSum[curN - i] == twoadicSum[curN] && !marked[curN - i][curK - 1]) {
                    marked[curN - i][curK - 1] = true;
                    q.offer(new int[]{curN - i, curK - 1});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = traversal.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            int[] cur = traversal.get(i);
            int curN = cur[0];
            int curK = cur[1];
            
            if (curN == 0) {
                memo[curN][curK] = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if (curK == 0) {
                memo[curN][curK] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            
            int step = 1 << log2arr[curN];
            for (int i_val = curN; i_val >= step; i_val -= 2) {
                if (twoadicSum[i_val] + twoadicSum[curN - i_val] == twoadicSum[curN]) {
                    memo[curN][curK] = (int) ((memo[curN][curK] + (long) binomial(curN, i_val) * memo[curN - i_val][curK - 1] % MOD * curK) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }
        
        return memo[N][K];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        DataInputStream in = new DataInputStream(System.in);
        int[] nBuffer = new int[1];
        int[] kBuffer = new int[1];
        long[] MODBuffer = new long[1];
        int[] idx = new int[1];
        idx[0] = 0;
        
        readInt(in, nBuffer, idx);
        idx[0] = 0;
        readInt(in, kBuffer, idx);
        idx[0] = 0;
        readLL(in, MODBuffer, idx);
        
        int n = nBuffer[0];
        int k = kBuffer[0];
        MOD = MODBuffer[0];
        
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 262155; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 31; ++j) {
                memo[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        log2arr[0] = -1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= 262150; ++i) {
            fact[i] = (int) (((long) fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD);
            log2arr[i] = log2arr[i >> 1] + 1;
            twoadicSum[i] = twoadicSum[i - 1] + get2adic(i);
        }
        
        invFact[262150] = modExp(fact[262150], (int)(MOD - 2));
        for (int i = 262149; i >= 1; --i) {
            invFact[i] = (int) (((long) invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MOD);
        }
        
        invFact[0] = invFact[1];
        
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modExp(k, n));
        } else {
            int total = modExp(k, n);
            int result = iterativeDP(n, k);
            int ans = ((total - result) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
            System.out.println(ans);
        }
    }
}
